smaller_candidate.interpretation: The restriction is corrected but this search still finds no valid smaller layout. Not a proof of geometric infeasibility.

second_smaller_candidate.interpretation: Neither neighbouring outline is recovered by wall-aware facing alone. Investigate obstacle-conditioned projection allocation and separation search rather than interpreting a static split failure as hardware infeasibility.

limits: Construction screens are not full qualification. No new smaller board, speedup, render or historical Python timing comparison claimed. Previously qualified reference PCB bytes are unchanged.
